tests.title: V2 customization specs round-trip
tests.description: Construct a v2 SoulDraftContent with identity theme/emoji plus persona, avatar, voice, and memory specs, serialize, parse, and assert nested fields survive.

tests.title: Customization content auto-marks v2 schema
tests.description: Serialize schema-less draft content with v2-only customization fields and assert the emitted JSON carries soulfactory-draft/v2 without mutating the original struct.

tests.title: V1 migration compatibility
tests.description: Parse no-schema legacy draft content and assert migration to latest preserves legacy fields while seeding nested avatar and voice specs.

tests.title: Customization fields affect spec hash
tests.description: Hash a v2 draft with customization fields twice for stability, then mutate memory search config and assert the hash changes.

tests.title: Runtime params migrate v1 draft fields
tests.description: Build runtime provisioning params from a pure v1 draft and assert avatar_prompt, assets.avatar_ref, and assets.voice_ref are present in migrated nested v2 fields.
